writer.headline: AI money surged; power and rules bit

tldr.text: AI funding kept fattening up, with big rounds and bigger valuations.
Power limits got louder: data centres, supply shocks, and GaN got airtime.
India’s rulebook got sharper, while election and oil threads stayed messy.

intro.text: Biggest shift: AI Money Shift went from newborn to heating fast, with capital chasing tooling, robotics, and infra. Around it, The Power Limit got more real, while Governance Guardrails and Regulation vs Press showed the rules are now part of the story.
intro.highlight: AI Money Shift went from newborn to heating fast

threads.line: AI Money Shift heated up as capital kept piling into AI tooling, robotics, vision hardware, and late-stage infra, with valuations still doing gymnastics.
Governance Guardrails warmed further: AI is moving from founder vibes to institutional controls, disclosures, and trust drama.
The Power Limit got hotter as AI’s thirst for electricity ran into supply, siting, and power-electronics constraints.
Fragmented Israel stayed heating because high turnout and a likely no-majority result point to long coalition wrangling.
Refinery Shock intensified as oil spikes from supply disruptions kept feeding straight into inflation pressure.
Regulation vs Press heated up as courts, media groups, and policy talks pushed back on new rules and shaped how they land.
Roll Trim stayed hot as the Election Commission kept tightening documentation and trimming rolls, triggering visible pushback.

writer.watch: Watch whether AI capital keeps clustering into a few mega-winners, and whether power constraints turn into real deployment delays. Also watch if India’s regulatory pushback hardens into actual rule changes, not just courtroom noise.
